title: Hard Times Creamed Tuna
description: This budget-friendly creamed tuna on toast recipe stretches a can of tuna into dinner for four when heated in a creamy sauce and served over toast.
ingredients: 1 (5 ounce) can chunk light tuna in water, drained and flaked
salt and ground black pepper to taste
4 slices bread, toasted, or to taste

steps.text: Melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir flour into melted butter until smooth to make a roux. Slowly stream milk into the mixture while whisking continually. Bring mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium-low. Stir tuna into the milk mixture; season with salt and pepper. Cook until tuna is warmed, 2 to 3 minutes.
Ladle tuna mixture over toasted bread to serve.

video.description: When times are tough, it’s time to grab some creamed tuna on toast. But even if you are just trying to make it to payday, this dish still tastes great! The versatile snack in this video works great when you're in a hurry, or have limited supplies on hand.
video.name: We Tried a Creamed Tuna Recipe That's Perfect for Hard Times
